title: Zenith server config (zenith.yml)
description: Operational config loaded next to the executable (AppContext.BaseDirectory), or under ZENITH_DATA in Docker (/data/zenith.yml). Boot validation in ServerConfig.Validate() remains the runtime SSOT — this schema is IDE DX only.

motd.description: Primary MOTD shown in the server list.

max-players-per-ip.description: Concurrent sessions allowed from the same IP.

gamemode.description: Uniform join mode for all players (no /gamemode yet).

path.description: Data root. Empty = InMemory (volatile, no warning). Non-empty ⇒ LevelDB at {path}/worlds/{name}/. Relative paths resolve against the DLL directory, not shell cwd.

spawn-chunk-radius.description: Max view chunk radius advertised to the client on join (ChunkRadiusUpdated / ChunkStream).

spawn-ready-radius.description: Columns loaded/published before PLAYER_SPAWN (0..spawn-chunk-radius). ADR §70 ready-disk.

terrain.description: Base terrain generator (ADR §63/§64). flat = classic Y -61; noise = overworld band + features. Existing c: blobs win over config on load.

seed.description: Seed for noise terrain (heights, caves, trees, ruins); ignored for flat.

accept.description: Who may join. xbox = Microsoft FULL; self-signed = type 2 (xname+leguuid); offline = ClientData/chain name fallbacks. Public exposure: [xbox] only. Do not use require-chain-signatures (removed).

compression-threshold.description: Bytes above which game packets are zlib-compressed.

log.description: Independent log severity for Bedrock/server vs RakNet. Missing section uses C# defaults (server=info, raknet=warn). Aliases are ladders mapped to LogLevel flags.

server.description: Bedrock/gameplay logger. info = Info|Warning|Error. debug/all enable Debug (join/place rejects, etc.).

raknet.description: RakNet transport logger. warn keeps drops/full/rate-limit; debug floods ACK/Incoming/Connected PID.

to-file.description: When true, also writes logs/zenith-<run>.log and a paired logs/zenith-diagnostics-<run>.jsonl (periodic metrics snapshots) under the data root, one pair per server run.
